name: Golden Whistle
text: The first card you play into a threatened lane each possession echoes at 40%. Open lanes do not trigger it.

name: Barry’s Tip Jar
text: End a possession on exactly 1 Energy: bank +1 Momentum. The held Energy still becomes Morale normally.

name: Nimbus Prototype
text: Your first Flying card each possession costs 0, but opening hands contain one fewer card.

name: Broken Scoreboard
text: Every 58 raw Impact produced in one possession creates a Goal, then resets Flow to x1.00. Build huge, then cash out.

name: Ministry Fine
text: Possession 1: cards cost +1. Every later possession: the first two cards cost 1 less.

name: Bottomless Butterbeer
text: Whenever a card returns to your hand, gain +0.18 Flow and +3 Fan Pressure.

name: Captain’s Armband
text: Playing three different roles in a row makes the third card retrigger at 40%.

name: Possessed Weather Vane
text: Weather modifiers are inverted: penalties become bonuses, bonuses become penalties.

name: Lucky Quaffle
text: The first Goal each possession retriggers the card that created it at 25%.

name: Repo Company Contract
text: At Flow x1.80+, cards also count as Crowd. At Flow x2.40+, they also count as Flying. High Flow changes what your deck is.
